threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think you can catch a bus to the 'Tube'—everyone knows the hidden gems and shortcuts for that late-night trek home now.
Last night, caught a guy dancing with a street lamp at Brixton station. The bus was late, but he spun like it was his stage. Pure Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Last week, I saw a guy in a full suit juggling oranges at the U-Bahn station. Just another typical morning in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you enjoy a spontaneous rap battle while waiting for the bus during a strike. The chaos creates a uniquely creative vibe!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Locals know to avoid BART during Civic Center chaos; they just walk to get ahead of those waiting for the next train due to delays.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the Muni this morning only to find it held for 20 mins due to a labradoodle blocking the tracks. Just another day in Civic Center.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every bar in Gràcia is open late, but many close by midnight. It’s all about the locals’ rhythm here.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newcomer by how they still carry a mapa in their hands, staring at it like it's a treasure map, rather than just using their phone.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for the bus at the stop instead of knowing to just walk a minute to catch the 38 at the next one.
Last night on the N133, a guy serenaded the whole bus with 'Wonderwall'—drunk, probably, but I think he had a better voice than some pros.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I heard a busker near Hermannplatz mixing rap with the sound of a nearby tram; that blend of chaos felt like home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a doner, sip a craft beer, and catch a spontaneous tandem bicycle race on a Tuesday afternoon. It's pure chaos.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know that the real way to get a burrito at La Taqueria is to order it 'dine-in' to avoid the wait at peak hours.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading commuters with a ukulele as we waited for a delayed bus. Classic Civic Center vibe—only in SF do delays come with live music.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about Gaudí and hype, but it’s the little plazas and the locals with their cats that make it home.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new by the way they order coffee—always asking for milk when a late is a better fit in this heat.
